Business Rates (2.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

Property Search

Search for properties

This endpoint returns a paginated list of properties which match the search criteria.

A typical use case would be to search for a property via this endpoint then use the HATEOAS links included in the results to view the summary valuation.

You must include at least one search query parameter to make a valid request:

  • postcode
  • billingAuthorityReference

The property search endpoint does not support pagination the same way as all the other paginated endpoints. After requesting a page of properties, you can query for the next page of results by specifying a combination of afterAddress and afterUarn - these will be the full address and UARN of the last property in your current page of search results. This is as if you were saying: "I've seen all properties up to here, give me what comes next."

The afterUarn parameter must only be used in addition to afterAddress. It's optional, but it's best to always include it, as some addresses might encompass multiple UARNs.

Authorizations:
User-Restricted
query Parameters
postcode
string

Filters the results to include properties which match the provided postcode. The search is not case sensitive and must contain the 'Outward Code' (e.g. RH1). This, or at least one other search parameter, must be included in your search.

billingAuthorityReference
string

Filters the results to include properties which are inside the provided billing authority. The search is not case sensitive and supports partial references. This, or at least one other search parameter, must be included in your search.

uarn
integer <int64>
Example: uarn=12345678901

Filters the results down to a single property with the given UARN. This, or at least one other search parameter, must be included in your search.

pageSize
integer <int32> [ 10 .. 100 ]
Default: 15

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the number of elements per page

afterAddress
string

The last property address you've retrieved if you want to get to the next page of results. The search will only return properties with address alphabetically after the specified address

afterUarn
integer <int64>

return only properties with UARNs greater than the specified UARN. Must be used in conjunction with afterAddress

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Valuations

Endpoints to retrieve valuations for a property. Valuation history will provide a list of valuations for a property. For each valuation the user may request either a summary or a detailed valuation projection.

Valuation history

This endpoint returns the valuation history for the given property.

The valuation history is a high level view of the rateable value which is available to everyone.

The VOA gives a rateable value or valuation to each non-domestic property and this is used by local councils to calculate a property’s business rates.

Authorizations:
User-Restricted
path Parameters
uarn
required
integer <int64>
Example: 12345678901

The Unique Address Reference Number (UARN) of the property

query Parameters
propertyLinkSubmissionId
string
Example: propertyLinkSubmissionId=PL123456

The property link you wish to filter the history on

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Responses

https://test-api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/organisations/business-rates/properties/{uarn}/valuations

Valuation

This endpoint returns both the summary valuation and the detailed valuation when projection is defined for the given property.

The summary valuation is a reduced version of the valuation which is available to everyone. The full valuation is available via the detailed valuation endpoint but requires you to link the property to your organisation.

The VOA gives a rateable value or valuation to each non-domestic property and this is used by local councils to calculate a property’s business rates.

Detailed Valuations and the ability to perform a digital Check via APIs

There are two distinct types of Valuation currently available via the APIs

  • Properties with a 'Bulk Class' valuation classified as a Bulk Class (with 2 Survey Units or less)
  • Properties with a 'Licensed Properties' valuation based on Fair Maintainable Turnover

Bulk Class properties are further broken down into:

  • Shops (Bulk Class 'S')
  • Offices (Bulk Class 'O')
  • Factories (Bulk Class 'F')
  • Warehouses (Bulk Class 'W')
  • Land (Bulk Class 'L')
  • Miscellaneous Category 3 (Bulk Class 'M') - Garage, Car Showroom and others
    • Primary descriptions - CG2, CG3, CG4, CM1, CS7
    • Primary descriptions - CX with a special category code of 413
  • Miscellaneous Category 4 (Bulk Class 'M') - Miscellaneous
    • Primary descriptions - CH, CH3, CL, CL1, CL2, CR, CR1, EL, EL1, EM, EM1, EN1, LI, LS, LT1, LT3, LT4, MP1, MR, MR1, CW2, IF4, LC, NX, IX
  • Miscellaneous Category 5 (Bulk Class 'M') - Holiday Accommodation and others
    • Primary descriptions - CH1, CH2, CG, CG1, CM
  • Miscellaneous Category 7 (Bulk Class 'M') - Car Parks
    • Primary descriptions - CP, CP1
  • Miscellaneous Category 11 (Bulk Class 'M') - Ad Rights, Beach Huts and others
    • Primary descriptions CA, CA1, CW1, LH1, LS2, LS3, MT2, NT1, TD2
    • Primary description of 'CX' and a special category code of either 018, 045, 146, 211, 419, 427 or 992
  • Miscellaneous Category 15 (Bulk Class 'M') - Club House
    • Primary descriptions - LC1
  • Miscellaneous Category 16 (Bulk Class 'M') - Leisure Centre/Hall
    • Primary descriptions - LC2, LC3, MH, MH1, NT3
  • Miscellaneous Category 18 (Bulk Class 'M') - Sports Grounds
    • Primary descriptions - LS4, LS5, LS6, LS7, MC, MC1

Licensed Properties are split into two types:

  • Pubs
  • Hotels and Guesthouses
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
path Parameters
uarn
required
integer <int64>
Example: 12345678901

The Unique Address Reference Number (UARN) of the property

valuationId
required
integer <int64>
Example: 12345678901

The valuation ID

query Parameters
projection
string
Default: "summary"
Enum: "summary" "detailed"

Return summary (simplified) projection, or detailed (full) view of the resource.

propertyLinkSubmissionId
string
Example: propertyLinkSubmissionId=PL123456

The property link ID of the property you wish to view (required with projection=detailed)

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Property Links

Endpoints for listing, viewing, and creating property links. There are two variants of each endpoint: one for the interested party, and one for the agent user dealing with the property link on behalf of their client.

My client's property links

This endpoint returns a paginated list of property links for all the organisation's clients.

Filtering by client organisation name is supported and recommended.

Results can be sorted by one of the following sort fields:

  • ADDRESS
  • BAREF
  • CLIENT
  • CREATED_DATE_TIME
  • STATUS
  • REPRESENTATION_STATUS*

* Sorting by this field is not supported in the developer Sandbox

Note that:

  • Agents can only access properties that have been assigned to them. Agents must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online Service.
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
query Parameters
address
string <= 1000 characters

Address, or part of the address (e.g. street name or postcode), to filter by

uarn
integer <int64>
Example: uarn=12345678901

The Unique Address Reference Number (UARN) of the property

billingAuthorityReference
required
string

Filters the results to include properties which are inside the provided billing authority.

clientOrganisation
string

client's organsiation name to filter by

status
string
Enum: "APPROVED" "PENDING" "DECLINED" "REVOKED" "MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED"

The status of a property link to filter by

appointedFromDate
string <date>
Example: appointedFromDate=2020-01-31

Filters the results to include only property-links where appointedDate is on or after this date

appointedToDate
string <date>
Example: appointedToDate=2020-12-31

Filters the results to include only property-links where appointedDate is on or before this date

page
integer <int32>
Default: 1

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the page number

pageSize
integer <int32> [ 10 .. 100 ]
Default: 15

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the number of elements per page

sortField
string
Enum: "ADDRESS" "BAREF" "CLIENT" "CREATED_DATE_TIME" "STATUS" "REPRESENTATION_STATUS"

Field to sort the results by

sortDirection
string
Enum: "ASC" "DESC"

Results will be sorted in the specified direction (ascending or descending)

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Create property link on client's behalf

This endpoint allows an agent user to link a property to their client's organisation.

Once you requested has been accepted there will a slight delay in processing the request (approximately a minute).

To confirm your request has completed you can poll the View Property Link endpoint to see if you can move onto the next step.

We recommend you don’t poll until a minute after the initial request was submitted.

Once you have confirmation your request has been processed you can then move onto uploading your evidence.

Once the property link has been approved by the VOA the user will be able to:

  • View the detailed valuation for the property
  • Submit a request to amend the details the VOA have for the property
  • Challenge the valuation

Note that:

  • The request will be processed by the VOA with human intervention. The state will be updated and is available via the view property link endpoint.
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Request Body schema: application/json
required
clientOrganisationId
required
integer <int64>

Unique ID for the client organisation

uarn
required
integer <int64>

The UARN (Unique Address Reference Number) of the property

capacity
required
string
Enum: "OWNER" "OCCUPIER" "OWNER_OCCUPIER"

The capacity of the organisation creating the link

providedEvidence
required
string
Enum: "RATES_BILL" "OTHER"

The type of evidence provided in the evidence array

required
Array of objects [ 1 .. 2 ] items
startDate
required
string

The start date as a ISO Date String

endDate
string

The end date as a ISO Date String. The End date must be at least one calendar day after the Start date.

My client's property link

This endpoint returns a detailed or summary view of a single property link claimed by an individual or organisation. The view is determined by the optional projection query parameter which can take one of the values: ["summary", "detailed"].

Note that:

  • Agents can only access properties that have been assigned to them. Agents must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online Service.

Attach property link evidence for a client

This endpoint allows an agent user to attach evidence supporting a property link made on behalf of their client.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Request

POST /my-organisation/clients/all/property-links/{propertyLinkSubmissionId}/evidence HTTP/1.1

AWS will respond with 204 NO CONTENT if the file is successfully uploaded. If there is an exception it will come directly from AWS in XML format. These responses are documented here: AWS Error Responses

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this: 

Content-Disposition: form-data; name="x-amz-meta-request-id"

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last part of the submitted form and must be a binary representation of the file. Base64 or other encoding formats are not supported.

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file restrictions are in place:

  • File names must not be blank and must conform to the regular expression in the JSON schema.
  • The file must be at least 1B and no bigger then 10MB

Status of property link evidence for a client

This endpoint allows an agent to retrieve information about the evidence file supporting a property link created on behalf of their client.

You will need to include the submission ID of the property link as well as the attachment reference in the URL of the GET request.

The attachment reference was included in the response from a previous POST to /my-organisation/property-links/{propertyLinkSubmissionId}/evidence

Note that:

  • Individuals or organisations can only access their own data, and must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online service.
Authorizations:
User-Restricted

required
string
Example: PLQQ2YMP

The submission ID of the property link

My organisation's property links

This endpoint returns a paginated list of property links claimed by an individual or organisation.

Results can be sorted by one of the following sort fields:

  • ADDRESS
  • AGENT*
  • BAREF
  • CREATED_DATE_TIME
  • STATUS

* Sorting by this field is not supported in the developer Sandbox

Note that:

  • Individuals or organisations can only access their own data, and must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online service.
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
query Parameters
address
string <= 1000 characters

Address, or part of the address (e.g. street name or postcode), to filter by

uarn
integer <int64>
Example: uarn=12345678901

The Unique Address Reference Number (UARN) of the property

billingAuthorityReference
required
string

Filters the results to include properties which are inside the provided billing authority.

status
string
Enum: "APPROVED" "PENDING" "DECLINED" "REVOKED" "MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED"

The status of a property link to filter by

page
integer <int32>
Default: 1

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the page number

pageSize
integer <int32> [ 10 .. 100 ]
Default: 15

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the number of elements per page

sortField
string
Enum: "ADDRESS" "AGENT" "BAREF" "CREATED_DATE_TIME" "STATUS"

Field to sort the results by

sortDirection
string
Enum: "ASC" "DESC"

Results will be sorted in the specified direction (ascending or descending)

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Create property link

This endpoint allows a user to link a property to their organisation.

Once you requested has been accepted there will a slight delay in processing the request (approximately a minute).

To confirm your request has completed you can poll Get Singular Property Link. to see if you can move onto the next step.

We recommend you don’t poll until a minute after the initial request was submitted.

Once you have confirmation your request has been processed you can then move onto uploading your evidence.

Once the property link has been approved by the VOA the user will be able to:

  • View the detailed valuation for the property
  • Submit a request to amend the details the VOA have for the property
  • Challenge the valuation

Note that:

  • The request will be processed by the VOA with human intervention. The state will be updated and is available via the view property link endpoint.

Attach property link evidence

This endpoint allows a user to attach evidence supporting a property link.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json

{
  "fileName": "some_file.jpg",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "successRedirect": "http://example.com/success",
  "errorRedirect": "http://example.com/error"
}

        "href": "https://www.upscan.tax.service.gov.uk",

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this: 

Content-Disposition: form-data; name="x-amz-meta-request-id"

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last part of the submitted form and must be a binary representation of the file. Base64 or other encoding formats are not supported.

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file restrictions are in place:

  • File names must not be blank and must conform to the regular expression in the JSON schema.
  • The file must be at least 1B and no bigger then 10MB

Create a check case

This endpoint allows a user to perform a ‘Check’ on a property owned by their organisation.

Once you requested has been accepted there will a slight delay in processing the request (approximately a minute).

To confirm your request has completed you can poll Get Singular Check Case. to see if you can move onto the next step.

We recommend you don’t poll until a minute after the initial request was submitted.

Once you have confirmation your request has been processed you can then move onto uploading your evidence.

The ‘Check’ is a review by the IP of the information held by the VOA for their property. The IP confirms the accuracy of the facts on which the rating list entry is based, provides missing factual information and amends property details as necessary.

Note that:

To perform a ‘Check’ the property must have been claimed by the IP and the claim approved by the VOA.

Detailed Valuations and the ability to perform a digital Check via APIs

There are two distinct types of Valuation currently available via the APIs

  • Properties with a 'Bulk Class' valuation classified as a Bulk Class (with 2 Survey Units or less)
  • Properties with a 'Licensed Properties' valuation based on Fair Maintainable Turnover

Bulk Class properties are further broken down into:

  • Shops (Bulk Class 'S')
  • Offices (Bulk Class 'O')
  • Factories (Bulk Class 'F')
  • Warehouses (Bulk Class 'W')
  • Land (Bulk Class 'L')
  • Miscellaneous Category 3 (Bulk Class 'M') - Garage, Car Showroom and others
    • Primary descriptions - CG2, CG3, CG4, CM1, CS7
    • Primary descriptions - CX with a special category code of 413
  • Miscellaneous Category 4 (Bulk Class 'M') - Miscellaneous
    • Primary descriptions - CH, CH3, CL, CL1, CL2, CR, CR1, EL, EL1, EM, EM1, EN1, LI, LS, LT1, LT3, LT4, MP1, MR, MR1, CW2, IF4, LC, NX, IX
  • Miscellaneous Category 5 (Bulk Class 'M') - Holiday Accommodation and others
    • Primary descriptions - CH1, CH2, CG, CG1, CM
  • Miscellaneous Category 7 (Bulk Class 'M') - Car Parks
    • Primary descriptions - CP, CP1
  • Miscellaneous Category 11 (Bulk Class 'M') - Ad Rights, Beach Huts and others
    • Primary descriptions CA, CA1, CW1, LH1, LS2, LS3, MT2, NT1, TD2
    • Primary description of 'CX' and a special category code of either 018, 045, 146, 211, 419, 427 or 992
  • Miscellaneous Category 15 (Bulk Class 'M') - Club House
    • Primary descriptions - LC1
  • Miscellaneous Category 16 (Bulk Class 'M') - Leisure Centre/Hall
    • Primary descriptions - LC2, LC3, MH, MH1, NT3
  • Miscellaneous Category 18 (Bulk Class 'M') - Sports Grounds
    • Primary descriptions - LS4, LS5, LS6, LS7, MC, MC1
  • Car Parking
    • Bulk properties with Car Parking should always replay existing values in the submission if they remain unchanged. If they are omitted it will be seen as a request to remove the parking values.

Licensed Properties are split into two types:

  • Pubs
  • Hotels and Guesthouses

Splits, merges and deletions

When you're submitting a check case in order to tell the VOA that:

  • the property has been split into more than one
  • the property has been merged with others
  • the property has been demolished, is being redeveloped, or is no longer used for business

You should include the effective date of the split / merge / deletion in the reconstitutionEffectiveDate field of your submission. This cannot be a future date.

Off System Valuation Checks

In certain cases a property's valuation will not fall into either of the two main categories (bulk class or licensed). You will not be able to request a detailed valuation for this property via the API. You will need to submit a Detailed Valuation Request (DVR) online and, once this has been actioned, you can download a PDF copy of the detailed valuation, and a check form (to be filled in). Both of these documents must be submitted in a "DVR Check" using this endpoint.

A DVR Check is similar to the other types of check, except you will not have an original valuation to submit. You will need to set the 'dvrCheck' flag to 'true' and omit both the 'originalValuation' and 'proposedCharacteristics' sections in your check submission. The property that you check in this fashion must be a property that's neither bulk class, nor licensed property, and you must have completed a DVR request to obtain a copy of the detailed valuation PDF.

Hardship

You can inform the VOA that you are experiencing financial hardship. In order to do so, you may submit a 'experiencingHardship' flag in conjunction with a list of reliefs that you are currently receiving. The recognised reliefs are:

  • Small business rate relief (enum value SMALL_BUSINESS_RATE_RELIEF)
  • Rural rate relief (enum value RURAL_RATE_RELIEF)
  • Business rates holiday for children's day nursery (enum value BUS_RATE_HOL_CHILD_DAY_NURSERY)
  • Expanded retail discount (enum value EXPANDED_RETAIL_DISCOUNT)
  • Retail, Hospitality and Leisure grant (enum value RETAIL_HOSPITALITY_LEISURE_GRANT)
  • COVID-19 business support grant (enum value COVID-19_BUSINESS_SUPPORT_GRANT)
  • Payments deferred (enum value PAYMENTS_DEFERRED)
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Request Body schema: application/json
required
valuationId
required
integer <int64> (ID)

Unique valuation reference number

propertyLinkSubmissionId
required
string non-empty

Unique reference number for the property link

reasonCode
required
string non-empty

Reason for Check case. Uses a lookup code.

Array of objects (Attachments) [ 0 .. 10 ] items

File attachments supporting the case

declaration
required
boolean
Value: true

Declaration that the information given in this form is correct and complete.

smallerProposer
required
boolean

Are you a smaller proposer (you are a smaller proposer if you have employed fewer than 10 people on average during the last 12 months. In that same period, you must also have had a turnover or balance sheet total of no more than £2 million.

experiencingHardship
boolean

Are you experiencing hardship

reliefsReceived
Array of strings
Items Enum: "SMALL_BUSINESS_RATE_RELIEF" "RURAL_RATE_RELIEF" "BUS_RATE_HOL_CHILD_DAY_NURSERY" "EXPANDED_RETAIL_DISCOUNT" "RETAIL_HOSPITALITY_LEISURE_GRANT" "COVID-19_BUSINESS_SUPPORT_GRANT" "PAYMENTS_DEFERRED"

Forms of relief you are currently receiving

dvrCheck
boolean

Is this a check following a completed Detailed Valuation Request (DVR)

reconstitutionEffectiveDate
string <date>

The date the property was split, merged, or removed. This cannot be a future date. This field is only allowed when 'reasonCode' is: split, merge, or remove property.

groupPreChallengeReviewId
number [ 1 .. 99999999 ]

A group pre-challenge review (GPCR) is an option offered by the Valuation Office (VO) to groups of property occupiers, owners or ratepayers of business and other non-domestic properties. It allows them to challenge the basis of the valuation in respect of local, regional or national schemes of valuation.

object (Detailed valuation )

Detailed valuation

Bulk changes (object) or Licensed premises changes (object)

Amendments to the factual details about the property or land. This field is required when the 'reasonCode' is one of: confirm/change property details, court decision, or change in local area. 'proposedCharacteristics' is not allowed when 'reasonCode' is: split, merge, or remove property; or when the 'dvrCheck' flag is set to true.

My organisation's check case

This endpoint allows a user to retrieve information about a single check case they have submitted.

You will need to include the property link submission ID of the property you raised a check against as a query parameter and the check submissionId as a url parameter.

Note that:

  • Individuals or organisations can only access their own data, and must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online service.

Attach check case evidence

This endpoint allows a user to attach evidence supporting a check case.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Request

POST /my-organisation/check-cases/{checkSubmissionId}/evidence HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ...
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json

{
  "fileName": "some_file.jpg",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "successRedirect": "http://example.com/success",
  "errorRedirect": "http://example.com/error"
}

Response

{
    "reference": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
    "uploadRequest": {
        "href": "https://www.upscan.tax.service.gov.uk",
        "fields": {
            "x-amz-meta-callback-url": "https://api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/business-rates-attachments/callback",
            "x-amz-date": "20180611T081926Z",
            "x-amz-credential": "ASIAxxxxxxxxx/20180202/eu-west-2/s3/aws4_request",
            "x-amz-algorithm": "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256",
            "key": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
            "acl": "private",
            "x-amz-signature": "xxxx",
            "Content-Type": "image/jpeg",
            "policy": "eyJjb25kaXRpb25zIjpbWyJjb250ZW50LWxlbmd0aC1yYW5nZSIsMTAyNDAwLDIwOTcxNTIwXV19",
            "success_action_redirect": "http://example.com/success",
            "error_action_redirect": "http://example.com/error"
        }
    }
}

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this:

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last field in the submitted form.

File names must not be blank and must not include certain forbidden characters, such as em-dashes, asterisks, question marks, colons, etc (for actual regex refer to the published JSON schema of the request)

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file size restrictions are in place:

  • Minimum file size: 1B
  • Maximum file size: 10MB

Create a client check case

This endpoint allows an Agent to perform a ‘Check’ on a property owned by the client organisation.

Once your request has been accepted there will a slight delay in processing the request (approximately a minute).

To confirm your request has completed you can poll Get Singular Check Case. to see if you can move onto the next step.

We recommend you don’t poll until a minute after the initial request was submitted.

Once you have confirmation your request has been processed you can then move onto uploading your evidence.

The ‘Check’ is a review by the IP’s Agent of the information held by the VOA for their property. The IP’s Agent confirms the accuracy of the facts on which the rating list entry is based, provides missing factual information and amends property details as necessary.

Note that:

To perform a ‘Check’ the property must have been claimed by the IP and the claim approved by the VOA.

Detailed Valuations and the ability to perform a digital Check via APIs

There are two distinct types of Valuation currently available via the APIs

  • Properties with a 'Bulk Class' valuation classified as a Bulk Class (with 2 Survey Units or less)
  • Properties with a 'Licensed Properties' valuation based on Fair Maintainable Turnover

Bulk Class properties are further broken down into:

  • Shops (Bulk Class 'S')
  • Offices (Bulk Class 'O')
  • Factories (Bulk Class 'F')
  • Warehouses (Bulk Class 'W')
  • Land (Bulk Class 'L')
  • Miscellaneous Category 3 (Bulk Class 'M') - Garage, Car Showroom and others
    • Primary descriptions - CG2, CG3, CG4, CM1, CS7
    • Primary descriptions - CX with a special category code of 413
  • Miscellaneous Category 4 (Bulk Class 'M') - Miscellaneous
    • Primary descriptions - CH, CH3, CL, CL1, CL2, CR, CR1, EL, EL1, EM, EM1, EN1, LI, LS, LT1, LT3, LT4, MP1, MR, MR1, CW2, IF4, LC, NX, IX
  • Miscellaneous Category 5 (Bulk Class 'M') - Holiday Accommodation and others
    • Primary descriptions - CH1, CH2, CG, CG1, CM
  • Miscellaneous Category 7 (Bulk Class 'M') - Car Parks
    • Primary descriptions - CP, CP1
  • Miscellaneous Category 11 (Bulk Class 'M') - Ad Rights, Beach Huts and others
    • Primary descriptions CA, CA1, CW1, LH1, LS2, LS3, MT2, NT1, TD2
    • Primary description of 'CX' and a special category code of either 018, 045, 146, 211, 419, 427 or 992
  • Miscellaneous Category 15 (Bulk Class 'M') - Club House
    • Primary descriptions - LC1
  • Miscellaneous Category 16 (Bulk Class 'M') - Leisure Centre/Hall
    • Primary descriptions - LC2, LC3, MH, MH1, NT3
  • Miscellaneous Category 18 (Bulk Class 'M') - Sports Grounds
    • Primary descriptions - LS4, LS5, LS6, LS7, MC, MC1
  • Car Parking
    • Bulk properties with Car Parking should always replay existing values in the submission if they remain unchanged. If they are omitted it will be seen as a request to remove the parking values.

Licensed Properties are split into two types:

  • Pubs
  • Hotels and Guesthouses

Splits, merges and deletions

When you're submitting a check case in order to tell the VOA that:

  • the property has been split into more than one
  • the property has been merged with others
  • the property has been demolished, is being redeveloped, or is no longer used for business

You should include the effective date of the split / merge / deletion in the reconstitutionEffectiveDate field of your submission. This cannot be a future date.

Off System Valuation Checks

In certain cases a property's valuation will not fall into either of the two main categories (bulk class or licensed). You will not be able to request a detailed valuation for this property via the API. You will need to submit a Detailed Valuation Request (DVR) online and, once this has been actioned, you can download a PDF copy of the detailed valuation, and a check form (to be filled in). Both of these documents must be submitted in a "DVR Check" using this endpoint.

A DVR Check is similar to the other types of check, except you will not have an original valuation to submit. You will need to set the 'dvrCheck' flag to 'true' and omit both the 'originalValuation' and 'proposedCharacteristics' sections in your check submission. The property that you check in this fashion must be a property that's neither bulk class, nor licensed property, and you must have completed a DVR request to obtain a copy of the detailed valuation PDF.

Hardship

You can inform the VOA that your client is experiencing financial hardship. In order to do so, you may submit a 'experiencingHardship' flag in conjunction with a list of reliefs that your client is currently receiving. The recognised reliefs are:

  • Small business rate relief (enum value SMALL_BUSINESS_RATE_RELIEF)
  • Rural rate relief (enum value RURAL_RATE_RELIEF)
  • Business rates holiday for children's day nursery (enum value BUS_RATE_HOL_CHILD_DAY_NURSERY)
  • Expanded retail discount (enum value EXPANDED_RETAIL_DISCOUNT)
  • Retail, Hospitality and Leisure grant (enum value RETAIL_HOSPITALITY_LEISURE_GRANT)
  • COVID-19 business support grant (enum value COVID-19_BUSINESS_SUPPORT_GRANT)
  • Payments deferred (enum value PAYMENTS_DEFERRED)

Declaration that the information given in this form is correct and complete.

Are you a smaller proposer (you are a smaller proposer if you have employed fewer than 10 people on average during the last 12 months. In that same period, you must also have had a turnover or balance sheet total of no more than £2 million.

boolean

Are you experiencing hardship

reliefsReceived
Array of strings

Forms of relief you are currently receiving

boolean

Is this a check following a completed Detailed Valuation Request (DVR)

reconstitutionEffectiveDate
string <date>

The date the property was split, merged, or removed. This cannot be a future date. This field is only allowed when 'reasonCode' is: split, merge, or remove property.

groupPreChallengeReviewId
number [ 1 .. 99999999 ]

A group pre-challenge review (GPCR) is an option offered by the Valuation Office (VO) to groups of property occupiers, owners or ratepayers of business and other non-domestic properties. It allows them to challenge the basis of the valuation in respect of local, regional or national schemes of valuation.

object (Detailed valuation )

Detailed valuation

Bulk changes (object) or Licensed premises changes (object) (ProposedCharacteristics)

Amendments to the factual details about the property or land. This field is required when the 'reasonCode' is one of: confirm/change property details, court decision, or change in local area. 'proposedCharacteristics' is not allowed when 'reasonCode' is: split, merge, or remove property; or when the 'dvrCheck' flag is set to true.

Attach check case evidence for client

This endpoint allows a user to attach evidence supporting a check case for a client.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Request

POST /my-organisation/clients/all/check-cases/{checkSubmissionId}/evidence HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ...
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json

{
  "fileName": "some_file.jpg",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "successRedirect": "http://example.com/success",
  "errorRedirect": "http://example.com/error"
}

Response

{
    "reference": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
    "uploadRequest": {
        "href": "https://www.upscan.tax.service.gov.uk",
        "fields": {
            "x-amz-meta-callback-url": "https://api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/business-rates-attachments/callback",
            "x-amz-date": "20180611T081926Z",
            "x-amz-credential": "ASIAxxxxxxxxx/20180202/eu-west-2/s3/aws4_request",
            "x-amz-algorithm": "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256",
            "key": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
            "acl": "private",
            "x-amz-signature": "xxxx",
            "Content-Type": "image/jpeg",
            "policy": "eyJjb25kaXRpb25zIjpbWyJjb250ZW50LWxlbmd0aC1yYW5nZSIsMTAyNDAwLDIwOTcxNTIwXV19",
            "success_action_redirect": "http://example.com/success",
            "error_action_redirect": "http://example.com/error"
        }
    }
}

...

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this: 

Content-Disposition: form-data; name="x-amz-meta-request-id"

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last field in the submitted form.

File names must not be blank and must not include certain forbidden characters, such as em-dashes, asterisks, question marks, colons, etc (for actual regex refer to the published JSON schema of the request)

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file size restrictions are in place:

  • Minimum file size: 1B
  • Maximum file size: 10MB

Challenge Cases

Endpoints for listing, viewing, and creating challenge cases. There are two variants of each endpoint: one for the interested party, and one for the agent user dealing with the challenge case on behalf of their client.

You will need to include the property link submission ID of the property you raised a challenge against.

Create a challenge case

This endpoint allows a user to perform a ‘Challenge’ on a property owned by their organisation.

Once your request has been received we'll review your challenge and tell you if it can be accepted within 4 weeks.

If your challenge isn't accepted we'll tell you why.

There is currently no digital function to access to confirm the status of the challenge.

The ‘Challenge’ is for IPs/Agents to tell the VOA that they disagree with the valuation.

Note that:

To perform a ‘Challenge’ you must have started a check on the property and the check must meet the required eligibility test

Authorizations:
User-Restricted
header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Request Body schema: application/json
required
valuationId
required
integer <int64>

Unique valuation reference number

checkCaseReference
required
string non-empty

Check case reference that relates to the challenge

propertyLinkSubmissionId
required
string non-empty

Submission ID of the property link that the challenge relates to

reasonCode
required
string non-empty

Reason for challenge case. Uses a lookup code.

proposedRateableValue
integer [ 0 .. 999999999 ]

The value you want to propose as the property's rateable value, the property’s rateable value is the estimate of the yearly rent it could have been let for on a date set in law (currently 1 April 2015). It might not be the actual rent as there are other factors to consider

proposedEffectiveDate
required
string <date>

When should your changes take effect? This date cannot be before the list of business rates valuations was published (currently 1 April 2017).

required
Array of objects (EvidenceFileDetails) [ 2 .. 10 ] items

File attachments supporting the case

object (ChallengeRentalData)

Rent details for rented properties

groupPreChallengeReviewId
integer [ 1 .. 99999999 ]

A group pre-challenge review (GPCR) is an option offered by the Valuation Office (VO) to groups of property occupiers, owners or ratepayers of business and other non-domestic properties. It allows them to challenge the basis of the valuation in respect of local, regional or national schemes of valuation.

declaration
required
boolean
Value: true

I declare that the information I have given is correct. If the information provided during a challenge is incorrect, this could lead to a penalty. The rateable value could also change, leading to a backdated business rates bill.

smallerProposer
boolean

Are you a smaller proposer (you are a smaller proposer if you have employed fewer than 10 people on average during the last 12 months. In that same period, you must also have had a turnover or balance sheet total of no more than £2 million.

experiencingHardship
boolean

Are you experiencing hardship

reliefsReceived
Array of strings
Items Enum: "SMALL_BUSINESS_RATE_RELIEF" "RURAL_RATE_RELIEF" "BUS_RATE_HOL_CHILD_DAY_NURSERY" "EXPANDED_RETAIL_DISCOUNT" "RETAIL_HOSPITALITY_LEISURE_GRANT" "COVID-19_BUSINESS_SUPPORT_GRANT" "PAYMENTS_DEFERRED"

Forms of relief you are currently receiving

Responses

https://test-api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/organisations/business-rates/my-organisation/challenge-cases

Attach challenge case evidence

This endpoint allows a user to attach evidence supporting a challenge case.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Request

POST /my-organisation/challenge-cases/{challengeSubmissionId}/evidence HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ...
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json

{
  "fileName": "some_file.jpg",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "successRedirect": "http://example.com/success",
  "errorRedirect": "http://example.com/error"
}

Response

{
    "reference": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
    "uploadRequest": {
        "href": "https://www.upscan.tax.service.gov.uk",
        "fields": {
            "x-amz-meta-callback-url": "https://api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/business-rates-attachments/callback",
            "x-amz-date": "20180611T081926Z",
            "x-amz-credential": "ASIAxxxxxxxxx/20180202/eu-west-2/s3/aws4_request",
            "x-amz-algorithm": "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256",
            "key": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
            "acl": "private",
            "x-amz-signature": "xxxx",
            "Content-Type": "image/jpeg",
            "policy": "eyJjb25kaXRpb25zIjpbWyJjb250ZW50LWxlbmd0aC1yYW5nZSIsMTAyNDAwLDIwOTcxNTIwXV19",
            "success_action_redirect": "http://example.com/success",
            "error_action_redirect": "http://example.com/error"
        }
    }
}

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this: 

Content-Disposition: form-data; name="x-amz-meta-request-id"

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last field in the submitted form.

File names must not be blank and must not include certain forbidden characters, such as em-dashes, asterisks, question marks, colons, etc (for actual regex refer to the published JSON schema of the request)

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file size restrictions are in place:

  • Minimum file size: 1B
  • Maximum file size: 10MB

Create a client challenge case

This endpoint allows an Agent to perform a ‘Challenge’ on a property owned by the client organisation.

Once your request has been received we'll review your challenge and tell you if it can be accepted within 4 weeks.

If your challenge isn't accepted we'll tell you why.

There is currently no digital function to access to confirm the status of the challenge.

The ‘Challenge’ is for IPs/Agents to tell the VOA that they disagree with the valuation.

Note that:

To perform a ‘Challenge’ you must have started a check on the property and the check must meet the required eligibility test

Authorizations:
User-Restricted
header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Request Body schema: application/json
required
valuationId
required
integer <int64>

Unique valuation reference number

checkCaseReference
required
string non-empty

Check case reference that relates to the challenge

propertyLinkSubmissionId
required
string non-empty

Submission ID of the property link that the challenge relates to

reasonCode
required
string non-empty

Reason for challenge case. Uses a lookup code.

proposedRateableValue
integer [ 0 .. 999999999 ]

The value you want to propose as the property's rateable value, the property’s rateable value is the estimate of the yearly rent it could have been let for on a date set in law (currently 1 April 2015). It might not be the actual rent as there are other factors to consider

proposedEffectiveDate
required
string <date>

When should your changes take effect? This date cannot be before the list of business rates valuations was published (currently 1 April 2017).

required
Array of objects (Attachment) [ 2 .. 10 ] items

File attachments supporting the case

object
groupPreChallengeReviewId
integer [ 1 .. 99999999 ]

A group pre-challenge review (GPCR) is an option offered by the Valuation Office (VO) to groups of property occupiers, owners or ratepayers of business and other non-domestic properties. It allows them to challenge the basis of the valuation in respect of local, regional or national schemes of valuation.

declaration
required
boolean
Value: true

I declare that the information I have given is correct. If the information provided during a challenge is incorrect, this could lead to a penalty. The rateable value could also change, leading to a backdated business rates bill.

smallerProposer
boolean

Are you a smaller proposer (you are a smaller proposer if you have employed fewer than 10 people on average during the last 12 months. In that same period, you must also have had a turnover or balance sheet total of no more than £2 million.

experiencingHardship
boolean

Are you experiencing hardship

reliefsReceived
Array of strings
Items Enum: "SMALL_BUSINESS_RATE_RELIEF" "RURAL_RATE_RELIEF" "BUS_RATE_HOL_CHILD_DAY_NURSERY" "EXPANDED_RETAIL_DISCOUNT" "RETAIL_HOSPITALITY_LEISURE_GRANT" "COVID-19_BUSINESS_SUPPORT_GRANT" "PAYMENTS_DEFERRED"

Forms of relief you are currently receiving

Attach challenge case evidence for clients

This endpoint allows a user to attach evidence supporting a challenge case for a client.

Attaching evidence is a two-step process:

  1. Call this endpoint and supply fileName, mimeType and - optionally - redirect URLs in the body of the request
  2. Upload the evidence file as a multi-part form using the form fields contained in the response from Step 1

Note: We recommend that the response fields are not hardcoded as these are subject to change.

Step 1

Request

POST /my-organisation/challenge-cases/{challengeSubmissionId}/evidence HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer ...
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json

{
  "fileName": "some_file.jpg",
  "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
  "successRedirect": "http://example.com/success",
  "errorRedirect": "http://example.com/error"
}

Response

{
    "reference": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
    "uploadRequest": {
        "href": "https://www.upscan.tax.service.gov.uk",
        "fields": {
            "x-amz-meta-callback-url": "https://api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/business-rates-attachments/callback",
            "x-amz-date": "20180611T081926Z",
            "x-amz-credential": "ASIAxxxxxxxxx/20180202/eu-west-2/s3/aws4_request",
            "x-amz-algorithm": "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256",
            "key": "533bedac-914a-474e-86d2-753d0b18f4bb",
            "acl": "private",
            "x-amz-signature": "xxxx",
            "Content-Type": "image/jpeg",
            "policy": "eyJjb25kaXRpb25zIjpbWyJjb250ZW50LWxlbmd0aC1yYW5nZSIsMTAyNDAwLDIwOTcxNTIwXV19",
            "success_action_redirect": "http://example.com/success",
            "error_action_redirect": "http://example.com/error"
        }
    }
}

...

N.B. names of the individual parts of the multipart form must be wrapped in double quotes and any whitespace around the equals sign is not permitted. E.g. each part should be formatted like this: 

Content-Disposition: form-data; name="x-amz-meta-request-id"

and not like this:

Content-Disposition: form-data; name = x-amz-meta-request-id

Or, the POST request could be made via a web form:

<form method="POST" href="...value of the href from the response above...">
    <input type="hidden" name="x-amz-algorithm" value="AWS4-HMAC-SHA256">
    ... all the fields returned in "fields" map in the response above ...
    <input type="file" name="file"/> <- form field representing the file to upload
    <input type="submit" value="OK"/>
</form>

Notes

The response to your file upload will be a HTTP 303 redirect to one of the URLs you may have provided in Step 1.

If the upload was successful, you will be redirected to the successRedirect URL. If you did not provide a successRedirect in Step 1, the response will be a 204 No Content.

If the upload failed, you will be redirected to the errorRedirect URL. Details about the nature of the error will be appended to the errorRedirect URL in the form of query parameters. If you did not provide an errorRedirect in Step 1, we will respond with the failure status code and a JSON body describing the error. The error document returned will have these fields: key, errorCode, errorMessage, errorResource, and errorRequestId. All fields are optional and of type String.

Whichever way the form is sent:

  • Use multipart encoding (multipart/form-data) NOT application/x-www-form-urlencoded. If you use application/x-www-form-urlencoded, AWS will return a response from which this error is not clear.
  • The 'file' field must be the last field in the submitted form.

File names must not be blank and must not include certain forbidden characters, such as em-dashes, asterisks, question marks, colons, etc (for actual regex refer to the published JSON schema of the request)

Currently, the only MIME types supported are:

  • application/msword
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  • application/vnd.ms-excel
  • application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.12
  • application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  • application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.formula
  • application/pdf
  • image/jpeg

The following file size restrictions are in place:

  • Minimum file size: 1B
  • Maximum file size: 10MB

Detailed message

This endpoint allows a user to retrieve information about a singular message relating to property links, check cases and challenges.

The message can be returned using one of the following projections:

  • legacy - (default in v 2.0) a legacy JSON structure of the message, potentially to be retired from future versions of the API
  • data - the response includes an array of data items that make up the message
  • html - a basic HTML-rendered version of the whole message is included as a field in the JSON response

Note that:

  • Individuals or organisations can only access their own data, and must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online service.

Agents

My clients

This endpoint returns a list of an agent's clients.

Note that:

  • Individuals or organisations can only access their own data, and must be enrolled for the Find and check your business rates valuation online service.
Authorizations:
User-Restricted
query Parameters
clientOrganisation
string

This parameter allows you to filter your clients by the start of their organisation's name

appointedFromDate
string <date>
Example: appointedFromDate=2020-01-31

Filters the results to include only clients appointed on or after this date

appointedToDate
string <date>
Example: appointedToDate=2020-12-31

Filters the results to include only clients appointed on or before this date

page
integer <int32>
Default: 1

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the page number

pageSize
integer <int32> [ 10 .. 100 ]
Default: 15

The results for this endpoint are paginated and this refers to the number of elements per page

header Parameters
Accept
required
string
Value: "application/vnd.hmrc.2.0+json"

Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used

Reference Data

Lookup values by type

This endpoint is designed for loading lookup values (reference data).

A lookup consists of a sequence of values. A lookup value is essentially a code-and-description pair and optionally a sort-order value. Where present, the sort-order provides the correct ordering of the lookup values.

There's a number of lookups of different types available in the system. This endpoint enables retrieval of the full set of lookup values of a provided lookup type.

Lookup types grouped by area of use

Valuation of shop/warehouse/office/land/misc

  • basisOfMeasurement
  • useCode
  • floor
  • year
  • adjCode
  • oaCode
  • otherAdditionsDfe

Valuation of licensed premises

  • lpAgeDfe
  • lpClass
  • lpExtension
  • lpGrade
  • lpLocation
  • lpType

Check case submission

  • codeOfGroundsDfe

Challenge case submission

  • challengeCodeOfGroundsDfe
Authorizations:
User-Restricted

required
string
header Parameters
